name: Do Not Pay
tagline: Pushes back on charges you should not be paying, and writes the letter
description: A bill you believe is wrong goes in: an overdraft charge, a card fee, a ticket, a deposit that never came back, a refund refused after a cancelled trip, a penalty from the tax office. What comes out is the argument against it, an honest read on where you stand, and a draft in the form the other side expects.
author: Dennison
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
